parameters.jsCode:
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Somebody said yes. Everything the confirmation needs is worked out here,
// before any calendar or email node runs, so the two branches below and the
// emails after them all read from one place.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

const context = $input.first().json;
const { booking, config, slot, event, owner } = context;
const online = booking.assessmentType === 'online';

const finalSummary = online
  ? `Site assessment (online) - ${booking.organisation}`
  : `Site assessment (on site) - ${booking.organisation}`;

const finalDescription = [
  `Free site assessment for ${booking.name} at ${booking.organisation}.`,
  '',
  `Type: ${booking.assessmentTypeLabel}`,
  `Sector: ${booking.propertyTypeLabel}`,
  `Site: ${booking.siteAddress}`,
  `Region: ${booking.siteRegionLabel}`,
  `Assessor: ${owner.name}`,
  '',
  `Client asked for: ${booking.preferredTimes || 'no preference given'}`,
  `Notes from the client: ${booking.notes || 'none'}`,
  '',
  `Contact: ${booking.phone} / ${booking.email}`,
  '',
  `Booked automatically from the website. ${config.businessName} - ${config.businessPhone}`,
].join('\n');

// A single block covering travel out, the walk-through, and travel back. It
// sits on the assessor's own calendar, never on the client's invitation.
const travelBlock = online
  ? null
  : {
      calendarId: owner.calendarId,
      summary: `Travel + site assessment - ${booking.organisation}`,
      startIso: slot.busyStartIso,
      endIso: slot.busyEndIso,
      description: [
        `${slot.travelBufferMinutes} minutes travel either side of the ${slot.durationMinutes} minute walk-through.`,
        `Site: ${booking.siteAddress}`,
        `Client: ${booking.name} - ${booking.phone}`,
      ].join('\n'),
    };

const clientSubject = online
  ? `Confirmed: your online site assessment, ${slot.human}`
  : `Confirmed: your site assessment at ${booking.siteAddress}, ${slot.human}`;

const clientBody = [
  `Hi ${booking.name.split(' ')[0] || booking.name},`,
  '',
  online
    ? `${owner.name} will meet you on Google Meet for your free site assessment.`
    : `${owner.name} will come out to ${booking.siteAddress} for your free site assessment.`,
  '',
  `When:  ${slot.human}`,
  online
    ? `Join:  ${event.meetLink || 'the link is on the calendar invitation'}`
    : `Where: ${booking.siteAddress}`,
  `Who:   ${owner.name}, ${config.businessName}`,
  `How long: about ${slot.durationMinutes} minutes`,
  '',
  'A calendar invitation is on its way to this address, so the time and',
  online ? 'the Meet link sit in your diary.' : 'the address sit in your diary.',
  '',
  !online
    ? 'If there is a sign-in process, an induction, or somewhere particular to park, reply and let us know so we arrive ready.'
    : 'If you would like anyone else on the call, forward the invitation to them.',
  '',
  `Need to move it? Reply to this email or call ${config.businessPhone}.`,
  '',
  config.businessName,
  config.businessPhone,
  config.officeAddress,
].filter((line) => line !== undefined).join('\n');

const teamSubject = `Locked in: ${booking.organisation} - ${slot.human} - ${owner.name}`;

const teamBody = [
  `${owner.name} has taken the ${booking.assessmentTypeLabel.toLowerCase()} for ${booking.organisation}.`,
  '',
  `When:  ${slot.human}`,
  online ? `Meet:  ${event.meetLink}` : `Where: ${booking.siteAddress}`,
  `Who:   ${booking.name}, ${booking.phone}, ${booking.email}`,
  '',
  !online
    ? `${slot.travelBufferMinutes} minutes of travel is blocked either side on ${owner.name}'s calendar.`
    : '',
  context.declinedBy?.length ? `Passed: ${context.declinedBy.join(', ')}.` : '',
  context.responderNote ? `${owner.name} added: "${context.responderNote}"` : '',
  '',
  'The client has been sent a calendar invitation and a confirmation email.',
]
  .filter((line) => line !== '')
  .join('\n');

return [
  {
    json: {
      ...context,
      online,
      finalSummary,
      finalDescription,
      attendees: [booking.email, owner.email],
      travelBlock,
      clientSubject,
      clientBody,
      teamSubject,
      teamBody,
    },
  },
];

parameters.content:
## Before this runs

1. **Team and settings** node - put the real work emails and calendar IDs in. Nothing else needs editing.
2. Connect a **Google Calendar** credential (the account must be able to write to the hold calendar and read the four team calendars) and a **Gmail** credential.
3. Save and activate, then copy the **production** webhook URL from the first node.
4. Point the website at it: set `ENQUIRY_TRANSPORT=n8n` and `N8N_BOOKING_WEBHOOK_URL=<that URL>` once the webhook transport is added in `lib/enquiry/transport.ts`.

It expects the form payload as JSON: `name, organisation, email, phone, siteRegion, assessmentType, propertyType, siteAddress, preferredTimes, notes`.

## Choosing the time

The form asks for preferred times as free text. **Normalise the booking** reads it (weekdays, "morning", "after 2pm", "Thursday 10:30") and ranks every working slot in the next fortnight against it.

**Pick the slot and who is free** crosses that ranking with real Google Calendar free/busy for all four and keeps the best slot at least one of them can actually make.

## Online vs on site

**Online** - 30 minutes, a Google Meet link is created on the event, no address needed.

**On site** - 90 minutes at the site address, and 45 minutes of travel each way must be free on the calendar before the slot is offered. The travel block is only written once someone confirms.

On-site visits outside metropolitan Melbourne never reach this point - they go to the office instead.

## The handshake

All four are emailed at once with a short form: **who are you** and **yes or no**.

- **First yes wins.** The client is then sent a real calendar invitation with the Meet link or the address, plus a confirmation email.
- **A no** takes that person off the list and re-asks whoever is left. The hold stays put.
- **Nobody answers in 6 hours, or everyone passes** - the hold is released and the office is told. The client is never given a time nobody agreed to.
